definitions.explanation: A mathematical relationship where one quantity increases as another decreases at a proportional rate. Also used figuratively to describe opposing trends.

examples.japanese: {速度|そくど}と{時間|じかん}は{反比例|はんぴれい}する。
examples.english: Speed and time are inversely proportional.

examples.japanese: {収入|しゅうにゅう}と{自由|じゆう}な{時間|じかん}は{反比例|はんぴれい}の{関係|かんけい}にある。
examples.english: Income and free time are in an inverse relationship.

examples.japanese: {反比例|はんぴれい}のグラフは{双曲線|そうきょくせん}になる。
examples.english: The graph of an inverse proportion forms a hyperbola.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with する to mean "to be inversely proportional." Taught in middle school mathematics. Also used loosely in everyday language to describe any situation where two things move in opposite directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反比例|はんぴれい}する (to be inversely proportional)
- {反比例|はんぴれい}の{関係|かんけい} (inverse relationship)
- {反比例|はんぴれい}のグラフ (inverse proportion graph)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {比例|ひれい}: proportion — a direct proportional relationship where both quantities increase together
